_doc: Corsair line skill definitions (spec #384, ticket C2 #386). Each skill ticket appends its own region of `skills` (separate tickets, separate regions): C3 Dash's mobility rank rule (Dash stays in skills/pirate.json); C4 #388 Double Shot, Burst Fire, Invisible Shot, Recoil Shot and Grenade (the four ported from pirate.json, then Burst Fire; first in the file); C5-C13 the rest of the pool (Flamethrower, Ice Splitter, Octopus, Gaviota, Homing Beacon, Aerial Strike, Rapid Fire, Battleship and its sub-skills). A pool key with no entry here stays inert: it is never offered, learned or cast. A key may be defined in one file only (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). Books may be 500, 520, 521 or 522. C2 defined none; C4 defines the five gun fillers.

double_shot.name: Double Shot
double_shot.desc: Fires two bullets at nearby monsters.
double_shot._tier: Tier A: bulletCount 2, range, damage 63..80% per bullet, the doublefire action and the CharLevel art; the eight survivor ranks map to WZ levels 3/5/8/10/13/15/18/20. Tier C (#388, GAME_DESIGN 7.120.4): moved from skills/pirate.json (the gun requirement and the twenty explicit ranks are gone, a weapon gates nothing), the bullets are the current ammo's (`ammo_shot`), auto-cast at the nearest monsters with the two bullets split over two monsters, cooldown 1s, action hold 0.6s, speed 600 px/s, radius 8px, no base pierce, rarity bonuses; untuned.

burst_fire.name: Burst Fire
burst_fire.desc: Fires three bullets at one monster.
burst_fire._tier: Tier A (Skill.wz 521.img): damage 125..210% per bullet at the mapped levels, bulletCount 3, range 350, the triplefire action, effect (8 frames), hit/0 (4 frames) and the Use sound; its Hit sound is a UOL to Double Shot's. Tier C (#388, GAME_DESIGN 7.120.4): `cast.focus` (all three bullets go to the one monster admission picked, a scheduled boss first, like Bowmaster's Strafe), the current ammo's bullets, cooldown 2s, speed 700 px/s, radius 6px, no base pierce, action hold 0.6s, rarity bonuses; untuned.

invisible_shot.name: Invisible Shot
invisible_shot.desc: Shoots the monsters in front of you and behind you.

text.desc: Fires at the monsters in front of you and behind you.
text.h: Damage {damage}%, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters} in front of and behind you

invisible_shot._tier: Tier A: canonical box reach 250 and height, damage 85..170%, mobCount 3, bulletConsume (ammo is endless here, 6.1.2) and hit art; its sound is the WZ Hit sound; the eight survivor ranks map to WZ levels 3/5/8/10/13/15/18/20. Tier C (owner #168, #388 GAME_DESIGN 7.120.4): cast.around mirrors the box's far reach to both sides, so it strikes in front and behind; moved from skills/pirate.json (no gun gate, no explicit ranks); auto-cast when a monster is inside the box, cooldown 1 s, the held gun's first basic-attack stance held 0.6 s, no visible bullet (the name; the WZ has no ball), rarity bonuses; untuned.

recoil_shot.name: Recoil Shot
recoil_shot.desc: Fires a shot at the nearest monster, then hops back away from it.

text.h: Damage {damage}%, then hop back away from the monster

recoil_shot._tier: Tier A: damage 90..260%, the backstep action, effect art, the Use sound and the hop `range` (115 to 250 px, read as the displacement); the eight survivor ranks map to WZ levels 3/5/8/10/13/15/18/20. Tier C (owner #168, #388 GAME_DESIGN 7.120.4): moved from skills/pirate.json (no gun gate, no Wings prerequisite, no explicit ranks); the shot is the current ammo's bullet (`ammo_shot`: Ammo.bullet_path, so Split and Mighty Bullets show) at 1000 px/s, radius 6, rotating, reach 300 px, no base pierce; the hop is instant and away from the faced monster after the shot, cut short at platform edges and walls (7.13), none while airborne; cooldown 1.8 s, action hold 0.6 s; the WZ has no hit art; rarity bonuses; untuned.

grenade.name: Grenade
grenade.desc: Throws a grenade at the nearest cluster of monsters.

text.desc: Throws a fully charged grenade at the nearest cluster of monsters; it explodes on the group.
text.h: Damage {damage}%, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters} around the blast

grenade._tier: Tier A: canonical blast box (-50,-50)..(50,20) around the landing point, damage 55..140%, mpCon (not read), mobCount 3 to 6, the ball, special (blast) and hit art, and the WZ Use2 and Hit sounds; the eight survivor ranks map to WZ levels 3/5/8/10/13/15/18/20. Tier C (owner #168, #388 GAME_DESIGN 7.120.4): moved from skills/pirate.json (no weapon gate, no explicit ranks); thrown as if fully charged with no wind-up (no prepare/keydown), auto-cast at the cluster (cast.rule cluster, GAME_DESIGN 7.20): the target is the nearest of the 12 nearest monsters within the throw range whose blast would strike the most monsters (a scheduled boss first), the ball flies there at `speed` px/s (never faster than 0.1 s) and the blast lands when it arrives; throw range 400 px, cooldown 2 s, the held weapon's first basic-attack stance held 0.6 s, rarity bonuses; untuned.

homing_beacon.name: Homing Beacon
homing_beacon.desc: Sends the parrot after the nearest monster and marks it: every hit on it deals more damage and your shots prefer it.
homing_beacon._tier: Tier A (WZ 5211006, book 521): damage 148..380% by level (172 / 260 / 380% at rank 1 / 4 / 8, levels 4 / 15 / 30), range 350, no time and no x (the mark's length is not in the WZ), the 4-frame parrot ball, the 6-frame effect, hit/0, the 5-frame mob loop (the mark art), the homing stance and the Use / Hit sounds. Tier C (spec #384 C8 #392, GAME_DESIGN 7.120.6): auto-cast nearest, 10 s cooldown, 500 px/s, 10 px radius, one target, no pierce, 0.6 s stance hold, the 8 s mark (x1.5, x1.25 on a boss, MobSwarm ALL_WEAK) and the rarity bonuses. Untuned.

battleship._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 5221006 (book 522, 10 levels, no action node): pdd = mdd 10 x level, so the eight mapped levels 2 3 4 5 7 8 9 10 (rank_levels["10"]) give a hull of 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 70 / 80 / 90 / 100 % of max HP (rank 1 / 4 / 8 = 20 / 50 / 100 %), the 11-frame effect and the 7-frame effect0 (z -1, behind the avatar; first frame 1x1 held 450 ms) cast art, and the Use sound; the WZ time (2,100,000 s) is 'until the hull is gone' and cooltime (90 s) is not used. Tier C (spec #384 CS-10, CS-11, C13 #397): a pool Form of the group corsair_ship, 15 s window, 45 s cooldown counted from the cast, admission when a living monster is within 400 px, no action node so the cast plays the gun's own shooting stance (weapon), the hull / only_skills / art_variant / presentation block, the Cannon at 0.8 s then every 1.4 s and the Torpedo at 1.6 s then every 3.0 s, the rarity bonuses. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.120.4.
battleship.name: Battleship
battleship.desc: Boards a battleship: its hull takes hits for you, and it fires its own cannon and torpedoes.

text.desc: Rides a battleship for 15 seconds. The hull absorbs the damage you take until it breaks. Only Grenade, Flamethrower and Ice Splitter fire while aboard, plus the ship's Cannon every 1.4 s and Torpedo every 3 s. Casts when a monster is near.

battleship_cannon._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 5221007 (book 522, req Battleship level 1): damage 205 to 380 % (the 30-level table 4 8 12 15 19 23 27 30 reads 220 / 240 / 270 / 285 / 305 / 345 / 365 / 380, so rank 1 / 4 / 8 = 220 / 285 / 380 %), bulletCount 3 (4 from level 11), range 400, weapon 49 (gun), the cannon action, its own 21 x 17 ball, hit/0 (4 frames) and the Use and Hit sounds (the same 2.3 s file). Tier C (spec #384, C13 #397): a Form sub of the Battleship with no slot and no card, nearest rule, 900 px/s, 8 px radius, no ammo shot (the ship's own shell), 1.4 s cooldown, the 0.8 s cannon stance hold. The sub ranks with its parent through its own 30-level table. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.120.4.
battleship_cannon.name: Battleship Cannon
battleship_cannon.desc: The ship's cannon fires several shells at the nearest monsters.

text.desc: While aboard the battleship, the ship fires a volley of cannon shells at the nearest monsters every 1.4 seconds.

battleship_torpedo._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 5221008 (book 522, req Battleship level 1): damage 390 to 780 % (the 30-level table reads 420 / 460 / 550 / 580 / 620 / 710 / 750 / 780, so rank 1 / 4 / 8 = 420 / 580 / 780 %), mobCount 4 to 6 (4 / 5 / 6 at rank 1 / 4 / 8), weapon 49 (gun), the torpedo action, its own 6-frame ball (30 ms), hit/0 (6 frames) and the Use and Hit sounds (the same 2.3 s file). Tier C (spec #384, C13 #397): a Form sub of the Battleship with no slot and no card, nearest rule, range 400 (the WZ node has a box lt (-400,-80) rb (-10,20) and no range), 700 px/s, 14 px radius, pierce_field mobCount (it strikes mobCount monsters, so it pierces mobCount - 1), 3.0 s cooldown, the 1.0 s torpedo stance hold. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.120.4.
battleship_torpedo.name: Battleship Torpedo
battleship_torpedo.desc: The ship launches a torpedo that pierces a line of monsters.

text.desc: While aboard the battleship, the ship launches a torpedo every 3 seconds that runs through several monsters in a line.
